body.name: Missing-edge bi-affine system
body.construction: For every absent bidirected pair \(\{i,j\}\notin B\), include \(\Sigma_{p(i),p(j)}x_i x_j-\Sigma_{p(i),j}x_i-\Sigma_{i,p(j)}x_j+\Sigma_{ij}=0\) when both nodes have parents, with the corresponding affine unary or constant equation when a node is a root; the collection is \(\mathcal E(G,\Sigma)\).
